Applying the template to the target yields the two logical precursors “C(=O)C(F)(F)F” and “C=CC1=CC=CC=C1”. These precursors satisfy the template, and the required JSON format can therefore be constructed with the target molecule as the root, a single reaction node using template 1914384, and the two precursor molecules as its children.</thought>
